items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; returns from absence.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury report; Schefter confirms expected to play.
items.implication: WR1 upside restored; possible snap limits per Levitan.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets rebound vs Eagles; Adams value may dilute.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN after hamstring; full practice Friday, no designation.
items.why: ETR report; elite DvP vs Cowboys (+7.3% WR scoring).
items.implication: Immediate WR1/2 start in favorable spot; Texans high implied points.
items.opportunity: Target share rebound as alpha WR.

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT (sprained ankle); ruled out Friday.
items.implication: Major target vacuum; short-term only expected.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison primary beneficiary home vs weak secondary.

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) vs Rams; Goedert also OUT (knee).
items.why: ETR list; Schefter ruled Smith out; Baun also out.
items.implication: Eagles offense significantly worse; Hurts downgrade.
items.opportunity: Dontayvion Wicks/others elevated; reverse prior beneficiaries if IN.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad); AD Mitchell also OUT.
Great to have Puka Nacua back (hip); speculation on limited snaps, monitor.
items.implication: Start but temper full workload expectations.
items.opportunity: Still high route volume likely; Adams competition.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins return; Cowboys inflate opp WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
Jordan Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline secondary with Jefferson OUT.
items.why: JJ absence creates target share spike.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); Charbonnet also listed OUT/practice limited.
items.why: ETR report; aggravated chest; role already eroded (GL to Wilson, pass to Holani).
items.implication: SEA RB committee opens; Levitan notes long-term eye-test still positive.

items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (torn ACL, season-ending); IR.
items.why: Confirmed ACL tear Week 3; ETR lists OUT.
items.implication: Drop in redraft; MIA backfield undefined (Wright/Gordon).

items.text: Jayden Daniels OUT; Caleb Williams also OUT (Bagent expected start).
items.why: ETR/Schefter lists; Rapoport Bagent first-team reps.
items.opportunity: Backup QBs and surrounding skill elevated slightly.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ yds to RBs every game; top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse usage + matchup + short week belief.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot) LP-DNP-LP; already cracked rib this season; Q tag.
items.why: Practice pattern concerning with prior injury.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton: low utilization (RB27), 3.5% target share, 42% snaps Week 3, 13% 3rd down; SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
